Question: The mean, median, and mode of the \(7\) data values \[60, 100, x, 40, 50, 200, 90\] are all equal to \(x.\) What is the value of \(x?\)
Solution:
The mean condition gives an equation that determines \(x\). The six known values sum to
\[
60+100+40+50+200+90=540.
\]
Since the mean of all seven values is \(x\), their total must be \(7x\). Thus
\[
540+x=7x,
\qquad 540=6x,
\qquad x=90.
\]
We must also check the median and mode. With \(x=90\), the values in increasing order are
\[
40,50,60,90,90,100,200.
\]
The median is the fourth value, \(90\). The unique mode is also \(90\), because it occurs twice while every other value occurs once. Therefore \(x=90\), choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
